title: IIT Bombay student dies by suicide after AI exam use

sentences.text: A second-year student at IIT Bombay died by suicide Friday evening after allegedly using a mobile phone to upload an exam question paper to an AI platform to seek answers, triggering campus protests.

Instructors counseled the student and assured him the incident would not affect his academic career, but his parents have lodged an FIR for abetment of suicide and named a professor as the invigilator.
The probe has been transferred to the Mumbai Police crime branch, and police have invoked the Prevention of Atrocities Act after the parents alleged casteist harassment.
The student's father, Ravindra Wakode, has refused to claim his son's body and demanded the arrest of those responsible, while the mother alleged her son was tortured.
This is the third reported suicide on the campus this year.
